notes: Starter dataset. References name the hadith collection and number but have NOT been reviewed by a scholar yet - verify before relying on them. Contributions with sources are welcome.

entries.text_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
entries.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
entries.translation_en: We have entered the morning and the whole kingdom of Allah entered the morning. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner. His is the dominion, to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilayka-n-nushur
entries.translation_en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, and by You we enter the evening. By You we live, and by You we die, and unto You is the resurrection.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
entries.transliteration: Ayat al-Kursi
entries.translation_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

entries.text_ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
entries.transliteration: Surat Al-Ikhlas (112)
entries.translation_en: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent. (Surat Al-Ikhlas, 112)

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana abduk, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika alayya, wa abu'u bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
entries.translation_en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant
entries.translation_en: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no god but You.

entries.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
entries.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
entries.translation_en: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

entries.text_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
entries.transliteration: Raditu billahi rabban, wa bil-islami dinan, wa bi-muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyyan
entries.translation_en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (ﷺ) as my Prophet.

entries.text_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
entries.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyumu bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn
entries.translation_en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, I call upon Your mercy for help. Rectify all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.

entries.text_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
entries.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
entries.translation_en: We have entered the evening and the whole kingdom of Allah entered the evening. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion, to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilayka-l-masir
entries.translation_en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning. By You we live and die, and to You is the final return.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni amsaytu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata arshika wa mala'ikataka wa jami'a khalqika annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I call You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
entries.translation_en: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this evening is from You alone, with no partner. So to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.

entries.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
entries.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimati-llahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
entries.translation_en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

entries.text_ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
entries.transliteration: Bismika-llahumma amutu wa ahya
entries.translation_en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak
entries.translation_en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.

entries.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
entries.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
entries.translation_en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

entries.text_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
entries.transliteration: Astaghfiru-llah
entries.translation_en: I seek forgiveness from Allah.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
entries.translation_en: O Allah, You are peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.

entries.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
entries.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
entries.translation_en: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs dominion and to Him belongs praise, and He is over all things capable.

entries.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
entries.transliteration: SubhanAllah
entries.translation_en: Glory be to Allah.

entries.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
entries.transliteration: Alhamdulillah
entries.translation_en: All praise is for Allah.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
entries.transliteration: Allahu Akbar
entries.translation_en: Allah is the Greatest.

entries.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ — اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
entries.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah... Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd
entries.translation_en: There is no god but Allah alone... O Allah, there is no one who can withhold what You give and there is no one who can give what You withhold. Wealth and power cannot benefit a person against You.

entries.text_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
entries.transliteration: Astaghfiru-llahal-adhimal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyumu wa atubu ilayh
entries.translation_en: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

entries.text_ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
entries.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa tub alayya innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim
entries.translation_en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Surely You are the Oft-Returning, the Merciful.

entries.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
entries.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih
entries.translation_en: Glory be to Allah and by His praise.

entries.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
entries.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
entries.translation_en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers. (Dua of Yunus ﷺ)

entries.text_ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
entries.transliteration: Subhanaka-llahumma wa bihamdik, la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
entries.translation_en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and by Your praise. There is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You.

entries.text_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
entries.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhab-an-nar
entries.translation_en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka-l-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ، وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ وَحُسْنَ عِبَادَتِكَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka-th-thabata fil-amr, wal-azimata alar-rushd, wa as'aluka shukra ni'matika wa husna ibadatik
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in my affairs, firmness in guidance, and I ask You for gratitude of Your favor and excellence in Your worship.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
entries.transliteration: Allahumma-hdini wa saddidni
entries.translation_en: O Allah, guide me and lead me to righteousness.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعِلْمَ النَّافِعَ، وَالرِّزْقَ الطَّيِّبَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الْمُتَقَبَّلَ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka-l-ilman-nafi', war-rizqat-tayyib, wal-'amala-l-mutaqabbal
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome sustenance, and accepted deeds.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
entries.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal
entries.translation_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness.

entries.text_ar: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
entries.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
entries.translation_en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best guardian.

entries.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
entries.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahlan
entries.translation_en: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make difficulty easy if You will.

entries.text_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
entries.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhab
entries.translation_en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

entries.text_ar: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
entries.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma
entries.translation_en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

entries.text_ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
entries.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli
entries.translation_en: My Lord, expand my breast and ease my task, and undo the knot in my tongue so that they may understand my speech.

entries.text_ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
entries.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
entries.translation_en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

entries.text_ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
entries.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana wa li-ikhwanina-lladhina sabaquna bil-iman
entries.translation_en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

entries.text_ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
entries.transliteration: Wa qur rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin wa a'udhu bika rabbi an yahdhurun
entries.translation_en: And say: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
